# One of my for 2020 is to read one book a month. Two months into the year and I am ahead of schedule with four down. | Alice Harmon, MBA · LinkedIn · 2020-02-19T00:00:00+00:00

**Alice Harmon, MBA**: Account Executive at Vertice AI | Helping Banks & Credit Unions Leverage Data to Drive Growth.

---

One of my #goals for 2020 is to read one book a month. Two months into the year and I am ahead of schedule with four down.

1. The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People
2. Stores That Stick
3. Capital Gaines
4. You Don't Know Jack or Jerry: From Small Town Roots To Financial Software Giant

These books were all different but still applicable in not only #business but all aspects of #life. Really enjoyed each one of them for their uniqueness. Looking for my next book, open to suggestions. Drop a comment if you have any recommendations.
